texts.preamble: Mohd Firoj And Ors vs Municipal Corporation Of Delhi Through ... on 16 August, 2023 Author: Siddharth Mridul Bench: Siddharth Mridul $~S-58 In The High Court Of Delhi At New Delhi Judgment Delivered On: 1 W.P.(C) 10796/2023 Mohd Firoj And Ors .. Versus Municipal Corporation Of Delhi Through Its Commissioner Dr Sp Mukherjee And Ors.
texts.arguments: For the sake of completeness, the said terms and conditions attached to the Certificates of Vending, are reproduced herein below:- "1. Vendor shall not have any other permanent or long-term vending certificate. 4. Vendor shall not give his vending certificate on rent in any way. 8. Vendor/Squatter shall insure that no hindrance be caused to pedestrian and vehicular moment. It should also be ensured that the quality of the products sold and services provided to the public conform to the prescribed standards of public health, hygienic conditions and safety. 10. The street vendor shall not do any unauthorized/illegal activity. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners states, that they do not pray for the relief of running their business from any particular vending site, within the zone where he has been permitted to vend by the Municipal Corporation of Delhi, and further, the limited relief that is prayed for, is to permit the petitioners to vend strictly, in accordance with the terms and conditions of the Certificates of Vending, issued by the Municipal Corporation of Delhi. 7.
texts.petitioner_arguments: Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners states, that they do not pray for the relief of running their business from any particular vending site, within the zone where he has been permitted to vend by the Municipal Corporation of Delhi, and further, the limited relief that is prayed for, is to permit the petitioners to vend strictly, in accordance with the terms and conditions of the Certificates of Vending, issued by the Municipal Corporation of Delhi. 7.
